title: Every instruction legible at 4.5:1
statement: Set every line that tells a learner what to do, hints and help included, at a contrast of at least 4.5:1, in sentence case and upright type.
example: An active help control measured 2.52167:1 and a textarea placeholder about 3.15:1, below the 4.5:1 normal text needs.
detail: A supplied UI review found the labels that tell a child what to do set in small gold, some in all capitals and one in italics, and called them the hardest lines on the screen to read (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/gold-standard/aladdin-p1-ui-review.reference.md`, lines 20 and 52). Computed styles then measured an active help control at 2.52167:1 and a textarea placeholder at approximately 3.15:1, where normal-size instructional text needs 4.5:1 under the course's design contract and WCAG 1.4.3 (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json`, lines 1769 and 1551). The repairs set the labels in ink and their natural case at weight 600, with the smallest raised to 14px, and the placeholder later measured 7.111:1 (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/gold-standard/STYLE-IMPLEMENTATION-by-residual.md`, line 13; `grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json`, line 1563).
against: The 4.5:1 bar is WCAG's for normal-size text, and large text needs 3:1: "WCAG AA asks for 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text, so they fail both." (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/gold-standard/aladdin-p1-ui-review.reference.md`, line 20).

evidence.quote: The lines that tell a child what to do are currently the hardest lines on the screen to read.
Several of them are also all caps, and one instruction is in italic.
Instructional copy gets the least legible treatment available
Native computed style gives15px faint text on paper (2.52167:1) with57.96875x24.5px box.
The placeholder composites to approximately 3.15:1 on white.
This is normal-size instructional text, requiring 4.5:1 under the existing design contract and WCAG 1.4.3.
use ink for labels, sentence case and display sans for instruction.
Existing ink, natural authored case, normal tracking, weight600; the three13px-or-smaller instructional labels use14px and1.45 leading.
Eligible actual L6 enabled empty/focused textarea measures7.111:1

citations.ref: W3C Web Accessibility Initiative, Understanding WCAG 2.2: Understanding SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (Level AA)
